comparisons.peer_topic: Data Center AI Inference Platforms and Cloud Services
comparisons.peer_summary: The company launched AI inference platforms combining software with Ada, Hopper, and Grace Hopper processors for generative AI and LLMs. It also introduced NVIDIA DGX Cloud and AI Foundations to help businesses create and operate custom large language models.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and NVIDIA are actively launching new hardware platforms and software ecosystems specifically designed to drive AI adoption in their respective markets. Intel focuses on client-side AI PCs with its Core Ultra processor family to capture demand, while NVIDIA focuses on server-side Data Center inference platforms using its Ada, Hopper, and Grace Hopper processors to support generative AI and large language models. Both companies view these specific product launches as critical drivers for their AI strategies.

sentences.text: We recently introduced our Intel Core Ultra processor family that serves as the CPU for the AI PC, which enables AI capabilities at the client level.

In Data Center, we launched AI inference platforms that combine our full-stack inference software with NVIDIA Ada, NVIDIA Hopper and NVIDIA Grace Hopper processors optimized for generative AI, LLMs and other AI workloads.

peer_results.rationale: Qualcomm's relevant disclosure focuses on the belief that 5G combined with on-device AI will drive adoption in automotive and IoT sectors. This is a strategic outlook on technology drivers rather than a comparable disclosure of specific AI product launches or client PC market strategy.
